evidence: Created "Test Gadget Pro" (tech, $129.99, 4.2, tags, spec, featured) via admin form; then edited name/price/rating/desc/tags/category(home)/featured. Changes correctly reflected in category pages (moved from Tech to Home grid) and product detail page (all fields matched saved values, incl. spec Weight:200g, Buy Now link, tags).

issue: Homepage featured collection does not update when a product is newly marked as featured
actual: Created/edited a product with Featured toggle ON (visible as "Featured" badge in admin list and on its detail page related items), but the homepage Featured section (home.featured) kept showing only the original 3 seeded featured items (Sony WH-1000XM5, Peloton Bike+, Dyson V15 Detect) even after re-navigating to Home from other pages. The new featured product never appeared there.

evidence: Search "SONY" (uppercase) matched name -> 1 result Sony WH-1000XM5. Search "vacuum" (lowercase, in description only) matched Dyson V15 Detect -> 1 result. Search "renamed-tag" (a tag) matched exactly the product carrying that tag -> 1 result. Counts accurate in all cases.

issue: Newly assigned tag on existing product does not become available as tag-filter choice
actual: Edited a product's tags to include "renamed-tag" and "edited-tag" (confirmed saved on detail page and matched by keyword search). Opened the advanced Filters panel on /products: the tag-filter list only shows the 35 original seeded tags (ambiance, android, apple, ... wireless) and never includes "renamed-tag" or "edited-tag", even after navigating away and back to the products page.

evidence: Created "FT5 Fitness Widget" with new tags "zzzgizmo, brandnewtag". Both tags appear on the product detail page and searching "zzzgizmo" in keyword search returns exactly that 1 product.

Edited "Test Gadget Pro Updated" tags from "qa-test, newfangled" to add "edited-tag", then to "renamed-tag, edited-tag" (renaming newfangled->renamed-tag, removing qa-test). Detail page tag list updated to exactly ["renamed-tag","edited-tag"] and keyword search for "renamed-tag" returned that product.

Created product under Tech category (appeared in /category/tech grid), then edited its category to Home Goods; it immediately disappeared from /category/tech and appeared in /category/home grid, and detail page showed category label "Home".

On /products, selecting "Fitness" in the category filter dropdown updated the grid to the 4 fitness products (FT5 Fitness Widget, Bowflex, Theragun, Peloton) and count to "4 products found"; selecting "All Categories" restored all 11.
Full /products list (11 items) shows for every product: category badge, name (heading), price, star rating, brief description paragraph, image, and a "Buy Now" purchase action link.

Sort "Newest" (default), "Top Rated" (4.9→4.0 descending), "Price: Low to High" ($59.99→$2495) and "Price: High to Low" ($2495→$59.99) all produced correctly ordered grids. Min-rating filter "4.5+ stars" reduced 11→9 products (excluding 4.0 and 4.4 rated items). Price-range minimum slider raised to $160 combined with 4.5+ rating reduced to 8 (correctly excluding the $149.99 item too).
All search/category/sort/price/rating/tag filter changes on /products updated the grid, order, and result count instantly in place without any page navigation or reload.
Category dropdown on /products (all/tech/home/fitness) and top-nav category links (/category/tech, /category/home) both correctly update the active category and displayed product set each time.

Admin product form exposes Category as a single required select (Tech Gadgets/Home Goods/Fitness) with no multi-select or none option; every product observed across categories/detail pages showed exactly one category label.

Combining min-rating 4.5+ and price-min $160 correctly returned only 8 products (excluding a 4.6-rated $149.99 item and lower-rated items), showing AND across criteria. Selecting tags "wireless"+"camera" together returned 2 products (Sony WH-1000XM5 which has "wireless", Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra which has "camera"), confirming OR/at-least-one-tag logic across selected tags.

Clicking the product image thumbnail for "Apple MacBook Pro 14\"" on /products navigated to /product/macbook-pro-14, the correct detail page for that same product. Name links behave identically (verified throughout testing).

Buy Now link for MacBook Pro has href="https://example.com/macbook-pro", target="_blank", rel="noopener noreferrer" — opens the external retailer page in a new tab. Confirmed the same pattern (external example.com/example-retailer.com URLs) across all products' Buy Now links in snapshots.

/product/nonexistent-product-xyz shows "Product Not Found" message with a link back to Browse All Products, no unrelated product data rendered. /category/nonexistent-category shows "Category Not Found" message, no product grid rendered.

issue: Newly created/edited products are not persisted; a page reload reverts the catalog to the original seed data
actual: After creating "Test Gadget Pro Updated" and "FT5 Fitness Widget" (verified present, 11 products total on /products), a full browser navigation/reload to another URL caused /products to revert to "9 products found" — the original seeded set only. Both admin-created/edited products were lost.

issue: Products can be published/created without required content (image, retailer link, specification)
actual: Created a product with only Name and Short Description filled (left Image URL, Affiliate Link, and Specifications entirely empty, price defaulted to $0). The admin form accepted it with no validation error, and the product ("Incomplete Product Test") immediately appeared live on the public /products browsing page with no image, no working retailer link, and no specs — violating the requirement that a product needs a valid image, valid retailer link, and at least one complete spec before being publishable.

evidence: Detail pages for Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra and Test Gadget Pro Updated (and others) display matching name, category label, star rating + numeric rating, price, brief description, full "My Review" text, tag chips, "Key Specifications" list, product image, and a "Buy Now" retailer action — all matching the values entered/seeded for that product.

Seeded products use relevant, on-topic tags/categories, e.g. Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra (Tech): smartphone/android/camera/flagship; Peloton Bike+ (Fitness): cardio/cycling/smart-equipment/subscription. These same category and tag values were identical when viewed via category browsing pages and the product detail page.

Sony WH-1000XM5 shows identical name/category(Tech)/price($399)/rating(4.8)/description across Homepage (Featured + Tech section), /category/tech, /products list, and /product/sony-wh-1000xm5 detail page. Detail page additionally renders the full, untruncated review paragraph and the complete specifications list (5 specs), whereas list/homepage views only show the short description as designed.
